threads.question: H1 — Does finer analytical terrain/sampling improve physical profiles? Early Welsh/England terrain research, before the Atlas pivot
threads.historicalStatus: **PARTIAL**. [Public development entries](../development-log.md#2026-09-02--high-resolution-welsh-terrain-experiment-v1), [second environment](../development-log.md#2026-09-02--high-resolution-terrain-generalisation-experiment-v2), [tooling](../../scripts/terrain_research/README.md): source resolution matters route-dependently; finer sampling of a coarse DEM is interpolation; COG and WCS bounded reads work.
threads.reason: Regional analytical profile/source-specific filter evaluation, not a prerequisite to qualified slope of a represented field.

threads.question: H2 — Can authoritative geometry be registered and independently inspected? Tryfan 001–004B
threads.historicalStatus: **CLOSED FOR FOUNDATION** for the retained pipeline. [Earth Lab guide](../../scripts/earth_lab/README.md), [004B configuration](../earth-lab/tryfan-004b-photo-fit.json), [log](../development-log.md#2026-09-24--meridian-earth-laboratory-004b-quantitative-alignment): imported R16 preserves broad skyline; position fitting was boundary-limited and not promoted.
threads.reason: Retained reference pipeline sufficient; photograph fit is not ground truth.

threads.question: H3 — What physical understanding can DEM morphology supply? Tryfan 005A
threads.historicalStatus: **PARTIAL**. [005A definition](../earth-lab/tryfan-005a-surface-analysis.json), [result log](../development-log.md#2026-09-24--meridian-earth-laboratory-005a-terrain-derived-surface-analysis): slope/aspect, curvature and detrended roughness at approximately 5/15/51 m expose coherent ridges/gullies and scale dependence.
threads.reason: More morphology/landform interpretations add methods, not a new persistent model.

threads.question: H4 — What do independent spectral observations and time add? Tryfan 005B/C and 010
threads.historicalStatus: **CLOSED** for the bounded observation proofs; wider interpretation **PARTIAL**. [005B](../earth-lab/tryfan-005b-sentinel2.json), [005C](../earth-lab/tryfan-005c-temporal-evidence.json), [temporal findings](../development-log.md#2026-09-25--meridian-earth-laboratory-005c-temporal-surface-evidence), [010](../earth-lab/tryfan-010-observed-natural-colour.md). Corrected mirror scale/offset handling; four seasons separate some spectral persistence from snow/phenology/illumination.
threads.reason: Dated evidence exists; material/state interpretation remains partial and excluded.

threads.question: H5 — Can contextual geology/habitat and observations infer underlying surface? Tryfan 006–008
threads.historicalStatus: **PARTIAL**; single six-class world abstraction **SUPERSEDED** by the later hybrid direction. [006](../earth-lab/tryfan-006-contextual-evidence.json), [007](../earth-lab/tryfan-007-underlying-surface.json), [008](../earth-lab/tryfan-008-uncertainty-audit.json), [results](../development-log.md#2026-09-25--meridian-earth-laboratory-007-uncertain-underlying-surface). Deterministic capped preferences yielded broad tendencies and high ambiguity; 008 found overlap/coarse context more important than missing coverage and refused further acquisition.
threads.reason: Historical exclusive heuristic classes are not pilot canonical truth.

threads.question: H6 — Can evidence-constrained synthetic detail improve appearance? Tryfan 009
threads.historicalStatus: **OPTIONAL / ADVANCED**; historical visual acceptance remains **PARTIAL**. [009 definition](../earth-lab/tryfan-009-surface-reconstruction.json), [log](../development-log.md#2026-09-28--meridian-earth-laboratory-009-reconstruction-v01): deterministic continuous renderer controls and reversible Unreal material were prepared. Fixed-camera improvement remained pending; transient captures were invalid.
threads.reason: Synthetic appearance optional and explicitly invented; excluded.

threads.question: H7 — Does DSM–DTM retain structure beyond bare earth? Tryfan 011, Riffelhorn 012B
threads.historicalStatus: **PARTIAL**. [011](../earth-lab/tryfan-011-observed-surface-height.md), [012B](../earth-lab/riffelhorn-012b-mountain-reconstruction.md): coherent differences exist; Swiss ice/debris/epoch differences dominate some regions. 011's manual interpretation is still pending.

threads.question: T7 — Can synthetic transition terrain solve spatial continuity without damaging form? Early blends → terminal two-band control

Endpoints/numerical continuity passed, protected terrain/parents survived, but synthetic 3.19/1.35 m depressions, collar deformation and coarse 41.84 m RMS handoff prevented adoption. Shared close-camera clipping/faceting also failed visual acceptance, including pure-common controls; exact renderer cause remains unknown.
